title: What if Agüero never joined City?
checked: Born 2 June 1988 (23 in summer 2011); 74 La Liga goals for Atletico (Wikipedia infobox); asked to leave 23 May 2011 (Wikipedia); signed 28 July 2011, five-year deal, about £35m (Wikipedia, Goal; some say £38m, so 'around'). Marwood quote (Goal, 22 May 2021); Agueroo said in 2012 he would have joined Real Madrid had they bid (Wikipedia). The old 'everything agreed with Juventus' line could not be confirmed: removed. 93:20 facts as city-2012-title. 260 goals, 184 PL goals, 5 PL titles, left 2021 (Wikipedia, mancity.com). What-if: at 2-2 City 87, United 89; Ferguson's real 20th title came in 2013.

lines.text: What if the man who scored ninety-three twenty never came to City?
lines.say: What if the man who scored ninety-three twenty never came to City?

lines.text: Summer 2011. Kun Agüero is twenty-three, and one of the deadliest strikers in Spain.
lines.say: Summer, twenty eleven. Kun Ahgwairoh is twenty-three, and one of the deadliest strikers in Spain.

lines.text: In May he asks Atlético to let him go, and the giants circle.
lines.say: In May he asks Atleteeko to let him go, and the giants circle.

scene.headline: Agüero asks Atlético to let him leave
scene.standfirst: The Argentine striker wants a bigger stage. Europe's biggest clubs are watching.

lines.text: City's director of football Brian Marwood later said Real Madrid and Juventus were pushing hard.

scene.text: Real Madrid and Juventus were pushing hard, so we had to get it done quickly.

lines.text: City moved fast. Around thirty-five million pounds, and he was theirs.
Now flip it. Real Madrid or Juventus get there first.
Final day of that season. City and QPR, two-two, ninety-three minutes gone.
lines.say: Final day of that season. City and Queens Park Rangers, two two, ninety-three minutes gone.

lines.text: In the real world, Balotelli pokes it to Agüero, and he wins the league.
lines.say: In the real world, Balotelly pokes it to Ahgwairoh, and he wins the league.

lines.text: In our world, there is no Agüero. It ends two-two, and City finish second.
Sir Alex Ferguson lifts title number twenty, a year early.
And City's wait for a first title since 1968 goes on.
lines.say: And City's wait for a first title since nineteen sixty-eight goes on.

lines.text: Back in the real world, Agüero scored two hundred and sixty goals for City. Nobody has scored more.
Five league titles. One transfer, and a whole decade looks different.
Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
